reason: Prioritize vdown4-rest3-g128 for a useful memory reduction hypothesis: it protects embeddings, the output head, and all value/down projections at 4 bits while using 3 bits elsewhere. It is unmeasured, so its quality and throughput are unknown. Keep int4-g128 as the measured quality-safe comparator: quality was 1.0 and peak memory was 2299.48 MiB, though throughput retention versus BF16 is not established. The observed lower-memory recipes missed the 0.95 quality gate. No recipe has demonstrated both quality and throughput gates.
